title: clodex codex result envelope
description: The result of one Codex invocation made through skills/clodex/runner/run-codex.sh. The runner authors every field except the contents of $defs.model_report: that sub-schema is what the runner hands to `codex --output-schema`, so it is the only part the model writes. The runner folds the model's report in, stamps finding ids, reconciles the final status against the process outcome, and validates this whole document. A stage may transition only on a valid envelope whose status is "complete".

schema_version.description: Envelope contract version. 1 for clodex v0.1.

invocation_id.description: Runner-generated: <role>-<UTC timestamp>-<random>. Prefixes every state file of this invocation and is the argument to run-codex.sh --resume.

role.description: Which Codex role ran. Determines the sandbox and the default model.

status.description: Reconciled by the runner, never taken from the model: a killed process is interrupted, a non-zero codex exit is failed, a missing or malformed model report is failed, a model-reported partial is partial. Only a clean exit plus a model-reported complete is complete.

model_status.description: What the model claimed about its own completeness, kept for auditing the reconciliation above. Null when there is no usable model report.

summary.description: The model's own summary of the work. Prose — never a control signal.

error.description: Why the runner failed this invocation closed, when it did. Runner-authored.

inputs.description: The input artifacts this invocation was given, hashed by the runner: the prompt file plus every --input path. Lets a later stage prove the reviewed artifact has not changed.

findings.description: The model's findings, each stamped by the runner with an id that is unique within this invocation.

id.description: Runner-assigned: F001, F002, ... in the order the model reported them.

exit.description: How the codex process ended. Entirely runner-observed.

code.description: Wait status of the codex process (128+N when it died on signal N).

signal.description: Signal number that killed the process, else null.

codex.description: What was asked of codex, and the handle needed to continue it.

session_id.description: Codex session id captured from the event stream. Null means this invocation cannot be resumed.

resumed.description: True when this envelope is the result of run-codex.sh --resume.

output.description: Where the full output of this invocation lives on disk.

events.description: codex --json event stream (NDJSON), appended across resumes.

model_report.description: Where codex was told to write the model's structured report. Absent on disk when the run produced none.

The model-authored part of the envelope, and the only part of it Codex is asked to produce. run-codex.sh exports this sub-schema to a file and passes it to `codex --output-schema`; the runner supplies every other field itself. Report only what you determined; the runner already knows the run's identity, timing and inputs.

status.description: Your own assessment: "complete" only if you finished the whole assignment you were given; "partial" if you stopped early, ran short of room, or left any part of it undone.

summary.description: A few sentences on what you did and what you concluded.

findings.description: Every issue you are reporting, most severe first. Empty when you found none.

detail.description: Why it is wrong and what it breaks. Empty string if the summary says it all.

location.description: file:line, or a section heading. Empty string when the finding is not tied to a place.
